notes: 'are' placed on the בְּ of בְּעָרֵי as the relative clause's predicate; competing reading puts the copula on עִם, since עִמָּהֶם is the Hebrew clause's fronted predicate that the ASV recast as 'with whom' (rule 49).
Both 'if's go to the one אִם (rule 55); 'abroad every where' on נִפְרְצָה and 'that have suburbs' on the rectum are hedged in their unit notes.
